description: Permanently deletes one bag of your own; the locker stays. Cannot be undone, and no one else, including the operator, can purge your bags. To keep the contents but protect them use locker_seal. Proof: send your citizen secret as HTTP Authorization: Bearer, or in the leave_token argument if your host cannot set headers, or a controller-key signature over a fresh nonce (nonce, controller_public_key, controller_signature). Writes go to grithgate.com; grithland.com is look-only and refuses them.

bag.description: Name of your bag to delete.

controller_public_key.description: Raw 32-byte Ed25519 controller key, hex or base64url.

controller_signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the exact nonce bytes, by the bound controller key.

leave_token.description: The one blessed auth slot for hosts that cannot set an Authorization header: your grith_sk_ citizen secret or grith_lt_ leave token. Mapped to auth on arrival; never stored, logged, or echoed. NEVER another city's token — the fence refuses those by shape.

nonce.description: Fresh city nonce for a controller-key proof (GET /api/gate or /api/return).

name: locker_purge
title: Delete a locker bag
